research_question: Does a common fixed GenAI model preserve warranted differences in hypothetical institutional equity-sleeve allocation, and how does mandate-onset workflow change that performance?

claim_scope.institutions: hypothetical explicit mandates, not calibrated real funds
claim_scope.heterogeneity_source: risk preference gamma in delegated objective; not heterogeneous private forecasts
claim_scope.decision: allocation within a fully invested equity sleeve across FF12 industries
claim_scope.identified_comparison: early retained mandate versus late mandate under one fixed model; workflow policy including position and context age
not_identified: separate causal mechanisms of mandate recognition, memory loss and numerical optimization failure

main.data_vintage: local manifest frozen on 2026-10-17; current revised CIZ data, not historical point-in-time vintage
main.window_selection: all 625 overlapping 60+36 month frames; future 36-month block never passed to model or oracle
main.return_units: monthly decimal excess return; percent values divided by 100 then monthly RF subtracted
main.mu: training sample mean of monthly industry excess returns
main.Sigma: training sample covariance, ddof=1, without shrinkage
main.oracle: independent constrained optimizer; SPD and KKT certification
main.adaptation: LIBERA combines Salcher quadratic preferences with long-only feasibility; not a published unified protocol replication
main.reference_not_truth: optimizer of the stated estimated objective, not true future returns or a recommended real-world portfolio
main.same_optimum_cases: retain all; classify using common optimum KKT certificates, never force different allocations

stages: interpret provided facts and identify missing mandate
fully reconsider and output final allocation
workflow.execution_order: 625 market-window complete blocks in deterministic hash order; each block contains all three gammas x two policies; gamma order and adjacent paired-policy order hashed independently. FRESH separate diagnostic campaign.
workflow.execution_logging: retain scheduled sequence, actual timestamps, complete requests/responses, model/backend manifest and any deviation; stop and version a new campaign if model revision changes
workflow.interpretation: onset, position and retention policy bundle; not isolated exposure-free timing effect

model.note: paper-evaluated target selected; local access and immutable revision must be verified before any run. Do not silently substitute installed smaller models.
model.backend_settings: freeze chat template, quantization, thinking implementation, sampling defaults, context limit, engine version, any seed and model hash in runtime manifest
model.context_overflow: fail and record; no silent truncation or change to output token budget

analysis.population: fixed public-data benchmark, not an independent sample of institutions or market periods
analysis.base_pass_note: LIBERA deterministic-target census; temperature zero does not guarantee backend determinism. No stochastic reproducibility claim.
analysis.descriptive_convergence: D_star-D_AI, where D=0.5*L1(w_i-w_j); sign alone is not failure evidence
analysis.invalid_outputs: all-case failure rate; do not repair or assign fake utility. Individual policy contrasts require both answers; institution-pair policy contrasts require all four answers (two gammas x two policies) on the same window. Report planned, valid and excluded counts and invalid-rate asymmetry.
analysis.negative_raw_gap_policy: retain signed direct gap and raw budget residual; flag tiny negative gaps explained by equality-multiplier times allowed budget mismatch. Do not clip or interpret them as beating the exact simplex optimum.
analysis.aggregation: per-gamma and per-pair mean, median, full distribution, and paired R4-minus-R1 differences; any all-case average is equal-case descriptive, not social welfare
analysis.inference: descriptive finite-corpus comparison; no iid standard errors, p-values, power claim or automatic population generalization
analysis.claim_rule: evaluate mandate-response error, direct utility loss, invalid outputs and signed convergence jointly. Mixed directions are mixed results; no composite score or arbitrary threshold. Complete-case differences describe that subset, not automatically the whole scheduled corpus. Recognizing gamma in prose is diagnostic only; it does not isolate recognition versus calculation failure.
analysis.missingness: report every scheduled, completed, invalid, transport-failed and overflowed case; never replace a difficult case based on observed output
analysis.transport_retry: no automatic retries; log failed request, mark missing, resolve infrastructure before a separately versioned full or prespecified resumed run
analysis.auxiliary_FRESH: one-step full-information diagnostic, not a call-budget-matched causal arm

numeric_implementation.tolerances_are: engineering precision checks, not paper-derived behavioral treatment values

module_roles.A_public_documents: contextual evidence and optional separate extraction extension; not actual institution inputs or gamma calibration
module_roles.P_Q_legacy: archived numerical prototypes, not main estimand

alternatives.reason: public evidence does not independently identify per-institution views and confidence; using the tested LLM for gold views is circular

alternatives.candidate: four real fund mandates converted to FF12 constraints
alternatives.reason: issuer nationality, blue-chip status and denominators cannot be reconstructed from industry returns; gamma cannot be inferred from prose
closer to total risk choice but requires a different public asset universe and independent benchmark, not an undocumented addition to FF12

submission.length_format_own_results_requirement: not specified in available overview; do not infer exemption
